hook: Dropped voters filed *Form 6* before EC's re-entry fix
hook_b: Dropped voters filed *Form 6* before EC's re-entry fix
tldr: Voters wrongly listed as Absent, Shifted, Dead or Duplicate in Hyderabad's draft roll are caught between Form 6 and re-filing the Enumeration Form.

beats.what: On Nov 6 the ECI said people on the ASDD list can get back on the roll by re-filing the Enumeration Form, but some BLOs told voters they had not been informed and pushed Form 6.
beats.why: Families in Kukatpally, Yakutpura and Sultan Shahi filed Form 6 before or without knowing about the Nov 6 announcement; one EF scan even pulled up a Khairatabad voter's details.
beats.care: The ECI has said no action will be taken against voters just because they were on an earlier roll and later filed Form 6.

causes.label: Names marked shifted in draft roll

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Some family members got a new EPIC card the same day the ECI announced the Enumeration Form route, while others are still off the roll.

cards.q: Dropped from the draft roll? What would help most?

qs: How many Hyderabad voters are on the ASDD list?
Will those who filed Form 6 need to do anything more?

facts.t: False information on Form 6 is punishable with up to *1 year* in jail, a fine, or both, under Section 31 of the RP Act, 1950.

viz.verdict: Two routes for the same problem leave dropped voters unsure which to use

learn.t: ASDD = Absent, Shifted, Dead, Duplicate list of names removed from the draft roll

watch: Whether the ECI issues fresh instructions to BLOs on the Enumeration Form route.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Electors face Form 6 and enumeration form quandary

fact: Hyderabad voters marked 'shifted' filed *Form 6*, missing EC's simpler re-entry route
twist: Form 6's declaration says it is for *first-time voters*, and false info carries up to *1 year* in jail under the RP Act.
